title: The Latest Crier for Sep 18, 2026
items:
Fall Intramurals - Flag Football Sign-Ups

Get your team together and register now for Intramural Flag Football. Games will be played on Monday evenings, and all experience levels are welcome! 
Sign up here: Flag Football Intramural Sign-Ups – Fill out form 

Stay tuned for upcoming sign-ups for: Pickleball, Sand Volleyball, Disc Golf, 3x3 Basketball, and Bags (Cornhole)

Language Placement Test

Students who need to take a Language Placement Test for Spanish or German can stop by the Vermeer Science Center (VSC), Room #241 from 11:00am-12:00pm on Tuesday, October 13th. Use the following link to add your name and select a time to confirm your attendance. Contact Dr. Ally Krogstad ( krogstada@central.edu ) or Prof. Oscar Reynaga ( reynagao@central.edu ) if you have any questions.

The St. Mary's Catholic Church shuttle bus will NOT run this Sunday 9-20-26.

The shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass will NOT run this Sunday 9/20/26. The Shuttle Bus will resume service on Sunday Sept 27, 2026. 
St. Mary's Catholic Church Sunday Mass this Sunday Sept 20 will be on the Central College campus at Douwstra Auditorium at 10:30 am. 

If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu.

Major Day: Explore. Discover. Declare!

Tuesday, September 22 | 11:00 a.m.--12:30 p.m. | BMW Rooms & Atrium, Maytag Not sure what you want to major or minor in? Major Day is the perfect place to start! First- and second-year students are invited to explore majors and minors, connect with faculty, ask questions, and discover new possibilities. Whether you're still exploring or ready to declare, this is a great opportunity to take the next step toward finding an academic path that fits your interests and goals. 
Come curious, bring your questions, and see where your interests can take you! We hope to see you at Major Day!

Show your school spirit by decorating a window for homecoming!

Sign up on your own or with up to 9 of your friends! We'll supply the red, white, and black paint, plus the brushes. All groups will be entered to win a $50 gift card, but the top prize is $100! Sign up here by 9/23 at 5 pm to enter. Windows will be judged on 10/2. See your area coordinator for more info on the judging criteria!

Check Your Email!!

We are sending out many internships and job opportunities to YOU through Handshake. There are quite a few Summer Internships for 2027 coming out right now and we don't want you to miss them! 
If you have turned off your notifications in Handshake - we can help you turn them back on. 

ALSO!! Look in your "Other" tab if you have that in Outlook. Handshake emails get funneled there too. 

We will try to label the emails with JOB or INTERNSHIP so you know that it is important.
